title: كم قطعة تتحمّل بطيخة عملاقة؟ 🔪🍉 How many cuts can a watermelon take? #Shorts
description:
🔪 How many cuts can a giant watermelon take?

Which round was the most satisfying? Tell me in the comments 👇
